title: A number changed on the Part Library page reaches an open part request
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with a line holding a part request for part A, quantity 1, not yet received.
  • Use a new part number that no part and no Part Library entry has yet.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  4. Replace the Part Number with the new number.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Work Orders in the top bar.
  7. Open work order 1.
  8. Click the Parts tab of work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 2:

  • The entry's detail page opens.

Step 3:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens.

Step 4:

  • Part Number shows the new number.

Step 5:

  • The window closes and the detail page shows the new number.

Step 6:

  • The Work Orders list opens.

Step 7:

  • Work order 1 opens, and the part request on its line shows the new number, with the same description and quantity 1.

Step 8:

  • The Parts tab lists the part request under the new number, and the old number is not shown.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S11-R3a: “Changing an entry's number or description on its detail page follows the part dialog's rules: S13-R12 to S13-R19, S13-N1, S13-N7, and S10-R23 to S10-R25.”
  • S13-R19: “A rename carries over to open work that holds this part, at every location: purchase order lines not yet fully received, part requests not yet received or returned, canned jobs, and returns that are not completed take the new number. A delivery that is not yet accepted is covered by its open purchase order lines. Receiving, ordering, applying a canned job and returning then find the renamed part.”
  • Terminology: “Open work → A purchase order line not yet fully received, a part request not yet received or returned, a canned job, and a return that is not completed.”
